en: Oh, what is that?!
Father!
A-alice?  Ohh, Alice, you made it?!
Oh I'm so thankful you're okay.  Let me get you out of there right now.
Don't bother.  No matter how much you beat on it, the gordalis will not break.
Gordalis?  You mean this thing you're trapped inside?
Yes.  This cage was created from formidable magic,
powerful enough that I daresay I won't be able to get out of it.
Father!  Don't give up before we've even tried!
Alice, leave me.  Get out of here and save yourself.
I can't, Father!  Are you really sure it's hopeless?  Isn't there something, anything, we can try?
Oh all right.  In that case check with Mikhail.  He might have some thoughts.
Ah, Mikhail, huh...
Understood, Father.  Let me go ask!
Alice, don't wear yourself out...
Father, are you okay? Still with us?
Ha ha ha ha. Oh, ohhh, Alice!
Hang on! I'm getting you out of there!
This should do it.  I have to be wearing this dress in order to use the holy sword.
All right, let's go.
Father!
Ha ha ha ha. Oh, ohhh, Alice!
Father, are you okay?  Still with us?
I'm fine.  I can't die yet.  I still have work to do after all.
Hang on!  I'm getting you out of there!
Is that even possible?  Can you?
With this holy sword I sure ought to be able to!
Oh, ohh!
Father!
Thanks.  Sorry to have worried you, Alice.
It's no problem.  I'm just glad you're all right.
Now, let's head home.  Mikhail will be waiting for us.
Right!
Kyaa!?
That's not good!  Now that the gordalis was destroyed, the labyrinth itself has begun to collapse!  Alice, let's move.  We've got to get out of here fast.
Understood!
